svg.desc: 6 resources (4 spatial cards, 0 logical resources in 0 group cards, 0 embedded route cards, 2 member cards) · 4 relationships Thin solid: dependency. Dashed: association. Thick dotted: connection. Nested boxes: containment. Edge color preserves the Terraform action when available. Service label backgrounds: orange = compute; green = storage; blue = network; red = IAM; gray = unclassified. Spatial card role marks: rounded rectangle = execution; cylinder = data store; hexagon = network.
